sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.*,p.purchased,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-i.qty lo,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.qty>0), dem AS (SELECT l.*,o.ordered,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-l.qty lo,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE l.qty>0), picks AS (SELECT d.product_id,d.id line_id,d.order_id,d.qty demand_qty,i.id inventory_id,i.location_id,i.qty inventory_qty,MIN(d.hi,i.hi)-MAX(d.lo,i.lo) picked FROM dem d JOIN inv i ON d.product_id=i.product_id AND d.lo<i.hi AND i.lo<d.hi) SELECT p.name AS product_name,AVG(100.0*x.picked/x.inventory_qty) AS average_pick_percentage FROM picks x JOIN products p ON x.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name
